data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root ‘INTAHAA’ which means ‘to begin’ or ‘to start’. data.etymology: Intiha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Beginning.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Intiha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إِنْتِحَاء
